title: ALDER: Discovering the Laws of a World by Acting in It
abstract: arXiv:2609.33728v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reliable world models should not only predict future states but express how actions change the world in an explicit, transparent and testable form, such as equations. Yet methods that rely on a fixed set of trajectories cannot distinguish equally good competing hypotheses, while searches over a fixed set of predefined candidates cannot discover equations outside the initial hypothesis space. We introduce ALDER (Action-guided Law Discovery, Evaluation, and Revision), a method that actively proposes novel experiments to test and revise models. Specifically, ALDER proposes parametric equations; a numerical optimizer fits their coefficients; an independent verifier tests these candidates on held-out data. To distinguish between competing valid hypotheses, a cost- and safety-aware selector queries interventions, in the form of novel experiments. translated_title: ALDER：通过在世界中行动来发现世界的规律
translated_abstract: 可靠的世界模型不仅应当预测未来状态，还应以显式、透明且可检验的形式（例如方程）来表达动作如何改变世界。然而，依赖固定轨迹集合的方法无法区分同样优秀的相互竞争的假设，而在固定的预定义候选集合上进行搜索的方法则无法发现初始假设空间之外的方程。我们提出了ALDER（行动引导的定律发现、评估与修订），一种主动提出新实验以测试和修订模型的方法。具体而言，ALDER提出参数化方程；数值优化器拟合其系数；独立的验证器在保留数据上对这些候选方程进行测试。为了区分相互竞争的有效假设，一个兼顾成本与安全的选择器以新实验的形式查询干预。由此产生的反例会更新证据账本，并引导下一次的结构修订。
tldr: ALDER通过主动设计并执行新实验来检验、区分和修订候选方程，从而在与世界的交互行动中发现显式、透明且可检验的世界规律。
en_tdlr: ALDER actively proposes novel experiments to test, distinguish, and revise candidate equations, thereby discovering explicit, transparent, and testable laws of a world by acting in it.
